messages:
rachel (AE): Team — Heads up: Global demo for BankWave (bankwave-prod) on 2026-05-02 09:00-10:30 PDT. They want two parallel demo rooms (EU + US), ~40 concurrent users each, expected peak ~45 req/s total per region, streaming chat enabled. Can we provision temporary scoped keys for both regions and bump hosted qps for the window? Need soft failover so if EU suffers capacity issues we can route to US. Also need the keys to auto-expire and be tied to IP ranges.

max (Solutions Eng): We can create two scoped keys with a regional affinity and per-key qps caps. Suggest 60 qps per region to allow headroom. Important: which model variant for EU vs US? We might prefer the quantized 8B in EU and 13B in US if latency allows. Also confirm if the demo will use long chat contexts (>1024 tokens) since that affects instance sizing and KV cache.

rachel (AE): They plan to use redwood-chat-8b-quant both regions for parity; avg token length ~220, occasional 1200-token transcript uploads (these will be handled offline). We need the keys to have TTL 5h and an audit tag for the customer name + deal id. Procurement asked whether demo usage will be billed or we can apply a demo credit.

liu (Infra Eng): For the numbers: 220 tokens * 45 req/s => ~9.9k tokens/s per region. That looks fine for hosted burst if we reserve ephemeral capacity, but EU peak windows are tight next week. If EU capacity can't be guaranteed, we can program policy-based routing to failover to US but expect +80ms median added RTT. To be safe, create the qps request now and include a fallback plan. Please DM the customer IP list.

rachel (AE): Sending IP ranges via DM. Also BankWave needs the keys to be scoped so they cannot access production org data and logs must be exportable after demo.

priya (CS): Security checklist: confirm DPA signed? Are they using real customer data in prompts? If so we need a short data protection note and masking guidance. We can provide a sanitized audit export after the event.

rachel (AE): DPA in place, they will use synthetic data for the demo.

quota-bot: quota-change-request created -> QCR-8600; owner=max; region=eu-central-1,us-west-2; requested-qps=60_per_region; window=2026-05-02T16:30:00Z to 2026-05-02T18:30:00Z; status=pending

max (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare the scoped-key payloads and request ops change. Example payload (ops please use):

```json
{
  "type": "scoped",
  "org": "bankwave-prod",
  "region": "eu-central-1",
  "qps": 60,
  "ttl_seconds": 18000,
  "allowed_ip_ranges": ["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.5/32"],
  "model": "redwood-chat-8b-quant",
  "streaming": true,
  "audit_tag": "deal-6721-bankwave-demo"
}
```

max (Solutions Eng): I'll mark billing tag demo-credit:true so finance doesn't invoice them, unless sales prefers to route charges to the PO.

liu (Infra Eng): Ops note: please specify start buffer (we usually enable keys 20m before start) and set monitoring alerts on 4xx/5xx spike and queueing latency. If EU capacity can't satisfy the request, we'll flip routing to us-west-2 and notify the channel.

quota-bot: QCR-8600 approved -> change-id CHG-4520; scoped-keys created: sk_bankwave_eu_1841259999, sk_bankwave_us_1841259999; start=2026-05-02T16:10:00Z; end=2026-05-02T21:10:00Z

max (Solutions Eng): Smoke test curl for streaming (replace KEY):

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_bankwave_eu_1841259999" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-8b-quant","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' \
  https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream
```

max (Solutions Eng): For load validation I've put together a small k6 script to simulate bursts; ops, please run this against the scoped key in staging first. Also flag: if the customer unexpectedly goes above 60 qps we will 429; so confirm acceptance of soft throttling behavior with the customer.

rachel (AE): I'll communicate the 60 qps cap and throttling behavior. Finance agreed to absorb demo credits. Please keep the audit logs handy; I'll request the post-demo export.

priya (CS): I'll prepare the audit-export instructions and a sample CSV schema. Also will coordinate with security to redact any sensitive tokens in logs.

rachel (AE): Thanks all — once keys are live I will run a smoke test with BankWave and confirm. If they insist on absolute zero throttling we may need a short Dedicated pool trial — I'll flag that immediately.
